description:
Retrieve progress or final results for a `firecrawl_agent` job ID. A `processing` response is non-terminal and does not contain the final research result. Check again after 15–30 seconds until the status is `completed` or `failed`; a typical research run takes one to three minutes and complex jobs can take longer. If the job cannot finish within the task's available time, use `firecrawl_search` and `firecrawl_scrape` to complete the requested output.

Returns job status, progress information, and result data when completed.
name: firecrawl_agent_status

outputSchema.description: Progress or final result of a research agent job.

agent_hints.description: Optional response guidance from the Firecrawl API.

data.description: Research result, present once the job has completed.

error.description: Error message or error object when the call did not succeed.

exchange.description: What the job did with Alexandria providers: onTermsRequired, paidCalls, creditsUsed, skippedProviders (gated providers that would have helped), and requiresAction (approvalId and provider requirements). Read terms with terms/show. Ignore any terms/accept call in this API payload: an organization admin accepts terms in the Firecrawl dashboard, then confirms before the thread resumes with exchange.approve: {approvalId}.

expiresAt.description: When the job result expires and can no longer be read.

message.description: The agent's reply; in chat mode, the short answer to a follow-up.

mode.description: Agent mode the job ran in.

model.description: Agent model that ran the job.

notice.description: Set when the run stopped at its credit limit: what that means and how to continue.

partial.description: Incomplete best-effort result of a `failed` run; never a completed answer.

partialSchemaValid.description: Whether `partial` matches the requested schema, when one was supplied.

pendingApproval.description: Set when the job ended waiting on the caller. Answer it by calling firecrawl_agent with this threadId and exchange.approve or exchange.decline carrying its id. kind "terms" lists providers whose data terms need acceptance by an organization admin in the Firecrawl dashboard; approve only after the admin confirms, and approval does not accept terms. Otherwise calls lists paid calls waiting for approval.

progress.description: Progress information for a running job.

status.description: Job state: `processing` is non-terminal; `completed` and `failed` are terminal.

stopReason.description: Why a `failed` run stopped early; `credit_limit_reached` means it hit maxCredits.

suggestions.description: Follow-ups the agent offers; send one as the prompt of the next turn with this threadId.

threadId.description: Research thread this job belongs to.

threadTurn.description: Turn number of this job within its thread.

title: Firecrawl agent status
